title: CourseAsCode Forum Activity
description: Schema for FRM_*.yaml Forum activity files

Type.description: Activity type identifier — must be FORUM

Description.description: Short description of the activity (from YamlActivity base)

ForumType.description: Forum type: General=open discussion, Blog=each user posts one thread, Single=one discussion, EachUser=each user posts one topic, QAndA=Q&A forum

Intro.description: Introduction text shown at the top of the forum

IntroFormat.description: Format of the Intro field: 0=MoodleAutoFormat, 1=HTML, 2=PlainText, 4=Markdown. Note: stored as integer unlike other *Format fields

SubscriptionMode.description: How users are subscribed: Optional=users choose, Forced=all subscribed, Auto=subscribed initially but can opt out, Disabled=no subscriptions

TrackingType.description: Read tracking: Off=disabled, Optional=user choice, Forced=always tracked

MaxAttachments.description: Maximum number of file attachments per post

CompletionDiscussions.description: Number of discussions required for completion

CompletionReplies.description: Number of replies required for completion

CompletionPosts.description: Number of posts (discussions + replies) required for completion

DisplayWordCount.description: Show word count on each forum post

DueDate.description: Due date as a Unix timestamp

CutoffDate.description: Cutoff date (no posts after this) as a Unix timestamp

AssessTimeStart.description: Start of rating period as a Unix timestamp

AssessTimeFinish.description: End of rating period as a Unix timestamp

RssType.description: RSS feed type: None, Discussions only, or all Posts

RssArticles.description: Number of articles to include in the RSS feed

WarnAfter.description: Warn users after this many posts in a given period

BlockAfter.description: Block users after this many posts in a given period

LockDiscussionAfter.description: Lock discussions after this many seconds of inactivity

GradeForum.description: Whether the whole forum is graded (as opposed to individual posts)
